audit_anchor: // ---- R227: the wis mental save wiring audit ----
audit_comment: The WSG camp-chain fold, the fourth seam round after gap closure: no new book pages, the R499 pattern applied to the camp chapter. One campsite flows through six landed headers: the rest quality and Table 38 fire (rules/wsgfire.h R474: the three fire sizes, the fuel ladder 6, 12, 18 turns for an eight-hour burn, the refuel ladder 3, 6, 9, the wind resistance 20, 30, 40, the rest penalties 1, 1, 2, 2, 3, 3, 4 hours, the plate economy 5-to-1 and 9-to-5), the fire starting and fuel rules (rules/wsgfuel.h R475: the 15 mph breeze bar, the 30 mph no-start maximum, the 2d20/3d20 start dice, the 3-turn small-fire grace, the capacity doubling 6 at 10 feet to 12 at 20), the wildfire rules (rules/wsgblaze.h R476: the spark carry 10, 20, 30 feet plus one foot per mph of wind, the growth ladder 1, 2, 4 turns, the 6-turn uncontrollable bar, the halving divisor), the tent quality system (rules/wsgsleep.h R473: the pole ladder 2, 4, 6, the 10 mph leak step with the 5 mph leak, the 25 percent damage chance), the natural shelters (rules/wsgshelter.h R471: the 3-turn material floor, the 6-turn lash) and the R499 temperature chain re-read for the seam. The findings: the uncontrollable bar of 6 turns is exactly one hour; the small-fire refuel interval and the grace period are the same 3 turns in two headers; the 20 mph wind value appears in three headers; the no-start maximum equals the medium fire wind resistance; the growth ladder is the only geometric ladder; the rest cold threshold is the R499 below-0 boundary and the rest hot threshold of 90 opens one degree past the protected no-damage top of 89; and the plate economy loses a flat 4 hours either way.
audit_label: R502 WSG camp chain fold audit

banner.provenance: No new book pages: every value is the landed original re-read from its header (wgfFireSizes, wgfFuel, wgfRefuel, wgfWindRes, wgfPenTempBelow0, wgfPlateTypicalNight, wflSmallRefuelGrace, wflNoStartWindMax, wcfUncontrollableTurns, wcfSparkCarrySmallFt, wcfGrowthSmallTurns, wrsAdequateMinPoles, wrsWindStepMph, wnsLashBaseTurns and kin) and re-pinned on the fold side so the ladder identities compile and ride the mutant battery. The findings: the one-hour uncontrollable bar; the two-header refuel grace identity; the twenty-mph triple agreement across fire, rest and shelter; the no-start-equals-medium identity; the arithmetic-versus-geometric ladder split; the R499 temperature seam on both the cold side (the same 0) and the hot side (90 opens one past the 89 protected top); and the flat 4-hour plate loss.
banner.sentinel: THE SETTLE: census 426 -> 427; the gap report stays 186 closed / 0 open (closed - no flips this round); the camp chain has no gaps.
banner.title: The WSG CAMP-CHAIN FOLD, R502: the fourth seam round after gap closure. The fire-size ladders (rules/wsgfire.h), the fire-start and fuel rules (rules/wsgfuel.h), the wildfire rules (rules/wsgblaze.h), the tent quality system (rules/wsgsleep.h) and the natural shelters (rules/wsgshelter.h) reconciled as one system: one campsite, one chain, every ladder and threshold cross-checked between its headers - and the rest-quality thresholds plugged into the R499 temperature chain.

bools.comment: the uncontrollable bar of 6 turns equals the 6 turns per hour - a fire left alone for exactly one hour becomes uncontrollable.
bools.name: wmcBarIsOneHour

bools.comment: the Table 38 small-fire refuel interval and the fuel-header grace period are the same 3 turns - two headers, one number.
bools.name: wmcRefuelGraceIdentity

bools.comment: the 20 mph value appears in three headers: the small fire wind resistance, the rest wind-penalty threshold, and the poor-shelter full-protection example.
bools.name: wmcWindTwentyTriple

bools.comment: the no-start wind maximum of 30 mph equals the medium fire wind resistance - the fire that cannot be started in such wind is the one that would have withstood it.
bools.name: wmcNoStartMatchesMedium

bools.comment: the growth ladder 1, 2, 4 doubles while the fuel, refuel, wind-resistance and spark ladders are all arithmetic - the only geometric ladder in the camp chain.
bools.name: wmcGrowthOnlyGeometric

bools.comment: the rest cold threshold is the R499 dress below-0 boundary value - the camp chain plugs into the temperature chain at the same 0.
bools.name: wmcRestColdSeamR499

bools.comment: the rest hot threshold of 90 opens one degree past the R499 protected no-damage top of 89, at heat band 18 - the camp chain plugs into the temperature chain on the hot side too.
bools.name: wmcRestHotSeamR499

bools.comment: the plate economy loses a flat 4 hours either way: 5 hours in plate rest like 1, and 9 rest like 5.
bools.name: wmcPlateFlatLoss

bools.comment: the inside leak of 5 mph per step is half the 10 mph step - the tent halves the wind it cannot stop.
bools.name: wmcLeakHalfStep

bools.comment: the pole ladder 2, 4, 6 is arithmetic: two more poles per quality tier.
bools.name: wmcPolesLinear

kills). Preflight GREEN (R501 WSG movement fall fold
